newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Il-Yang says develops chip material.
newsitem.headline: Il-Yang says develops chip material.

text.p: South Korea's Il-Yang Pharm Co Ltd said on Tuesday it had developed a raw material for photoresist, a core component of sophisticated memory chips.

Il-Yang said the material, which will be used in production of one gigabit and four gigabit dynamic random access memory (DRAM) chips, would be supplied to Samsung Electronics, the world's leading memory chip maker.
Brokers said shares of the company benefited from the news, rising 1,900 won to the stock's daily upper limit of 26,500.
